summary: News Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing daily buyback activity under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program, which authorizes repurchases of Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) common stock from time to time. The filing merely furnishes copies of information provided to the Australian Securities Exchange on the dates noted in Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, satisfying ASX daily disclosure requirements; no new authorization, price, premium, stake, advisor, or recommendation is stated. The program creates a modest ongoing bid for both share classes, but the daily ASX notices carry no standalone event risk; watch cumulative repurchase pace and cash deployment versus investment priorities.
